title: the code systems in the FHIR store (lane V, 2026-11-23)

findings.claim: The FHIR store caches its $lookup and $validate-code answers for minutes (374 s seen, about ten minutes by its own figure): after a code-system update or rollback it answers from the earlier version until then, and a 'not found' given while it is still storing a large system in the background is kept the same way; the load now waits before anyone asks, but a caller during an update still sees the earlier version

ATC cannot go into the FHIR store from what ships: its licence register row is permission-to-ask, so the store validates no medication code unless the site loads its own ATC index with a named acceptance (D-1114)

The install, the doctor, the signed update and lane M's mapping check do not yet run the loader: each is another lane's file, asked on #639 (comment 7105850281); there is no scheduled updater at all today ('No auto-update', apply_update.sh)
$subsumes fails on the deployed FHIR store ('Hibernate Search was not initialized'): hierarchy questions get only each code's parent property through $lookup
$lookup of ICD-10-CM M10.00 answers 'Unable to find code[null] in system[null]' while $validate-code finds the code and $lookup finds its neighbours; cause not found

Several CodeSystem resources of one url left the FHIR store answering from an older one after an update and after a rollback, whatever their status; the loader keeps one resource per system and its history
